pull_request.title: Infrastructure: pin software submodules and add node-bound Makefiles
pull_request.head: codex/software-submodules
pull_request.body:
First step of the requested software ownership migration (ADR-008). Adds the software/source, running and analysis structure and pins ACTS before nODD-specific additions. Registers the existing nodehammer and ODD comparison sources and the user-supplied IdRes CERN GitLab fork as Git submodules. Makefiles retain the acts-mac-studio ACTS Spack ci-dependencies environment and build optional tools outside their source checkouts.

IdRes stays at its original d54d0e3c465cc0308becb737b04364ce5c68ce16 revision. Its adapter accepts the externally built binary; make idres-run saves new results under build/idres rather than changing retained evidence. The authenticated fork checkout is verified; no anonymous-access or license claim is inferred.

Validation: make help, make doctor (DD4hep 1.38/DDG4, Geant4 11.4.2, 12 datasets), software gitlink checks, 13 nodehammer safeguard tests, session/project/token validators and token preview build passed. IdRes built with Spack GSL 2.8; 22 runs passed with 729 complete rows each, and four adapter controls passed. Both optional source submodules stay clean. The older Spack registry fingerprints differ from the current installation; the actual environment was reverified without changing it.

Software submodule initialization excludes Overleaf and skips ODD LFS assets. Source pinning does not assert that a new large-data download works. No detector parameters or scientific reference evidence are changed. Follow with #78, #79 and the calorimeter migration PR.
